plain: The strong-force twist angle is zero in the repo only because the gauge weight is assumed to be a positive number for every configuration; neither the Wilson form nor a whole-number winding count is what matters. A locality rule removes the textbook twist terms but stops protecting once licensed terms combine, so the real premise is that the weight has no complex phase, which survives averaging. That is free if force fields are records under the Admissibility axiom and the Euclidean weight is the quantum weight, which are the open walls T27 and T15.
